name: MonarchKanbanBoard
title: KanbanBoard
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.pager.HorizontalPager of columns with androidx.compose.material3.PrimaryScrollableTabRow and Tab; androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn per column; detectDragGesturesAfterLongPress on the board; androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu with DropdownMenuItem for Move to; MonarchDragHandle, MonarchButton and MonarchText
summary: A board of columns of cards where people move cards within and between columns by dragging, TalkBack actions or a Move to menu, with counts against work-in-progress limits.
whenToUse: For work that moves through stages, such as To do, Doing and Done, or a sales pipeline.
whenNotToUse: For planning work into sprints or releases with points and capacity, use MonarchBacklogPlanner. For ordering one list, use MonarchReorderableList; for a grid of tiles, MonarchSortableGrid.
api: @Composable fun <T> MonarchKanbanBoard(columns: List<MonarchKanbanColumn<T>>, key: (T) -> String, itemLabel: (T) -> String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, onMove: (suspend (move: MonarchKanbanMove<T>, columns: List<MonarchKanbanColumn<T>>) -> Unit)? = null, canMove: ((item: T, toColumnId: String, fromColumnId: String) -> Boolean)? = null, enforceWipLimits: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, itemEnabled: (T) -> Boolean = { true }, moveMenu: Boolean = true, minColumnWidth: Dp = MonarchKanbanBoardTokens.MinColumnWidth, pagerState: PagerState = rememberPagerState { columns.size }, labels: MonarchKanbanBoardLabels = MonarchKanbanBoardLabels(), menuIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, cardContent: @Composable ColumnScope.(item: T, state: MonarchKanbanCardState) -> Unit)

class MonarchKanbanColumn<T>(id: String, title: String, items: List<T>, wipLimit: Int? = null, emptyText: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null) { fun withItems(items: List<T>): MonarchKanbanColumn<T> }
data class MonarchKanbanMove<T>(item: T, itemKey: String, fromColumnId: String, fromIndex: Int, toColumnId: String, toIndex: Int)
class MonarchKanbanCardState(columnId: String, index: Int, dragging: Boolean, overlay: Boolean, pending: Boolean, enabled: Boolean)

class MonarchKanbanBoardLabels(handle: ((card: String) -> String)? = null, moveMenu: ((card: String) -> String)? = null, move: String? = null, moveTo: ((column: String) -> String)? = null, countText: ((count: Int, limit: Int?) -> String)? = null, count: ((count: Int, limit: Int?) -> String)? = null, empty: String? = null, blocked: String? = null, pickedUp: ((card: String, column: String, position: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, moved: ((card: String, column: String, position: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, dropped: ((card: String, column: String, position: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, cancelled: ((card: String, column: String) -> String)? = null, notAllowed: ((card: String, column: String) -> String)? = null, failed: ((card: String, column: String) -> String)? = null, actions: Map<MonarchDragHandleDirection, String> = emptyMap())

options.name: key
options.description: A stable, unique key for a card, across every column.

options.name: itemLabel
options.description: The plain-text name of a card, used in the handle's name, the menu and announcements.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the board. Give it a bounded height, such as a screen: its columns are lazy.

options.name: onMove
options.description: Saves a finished move with the columns after it. Without it cards cannot be moved. Throwing puts the card back and announces it.

options.name: canMove
options.type: ((item: T, toColumnId: String, fromColumnId: String) -> Boolean)?
options.description: Whether a card may go to another column. Its own column always takes it.

options.name: enforceWipLimits
options.description: A column at or over its wipLimit refuses cards from other columns.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether any card can be moved.

options.name: itemEnabled
options.description: Whether a card can be moved, such as one the person may not edit.

options.name: moveMenu
options.description: Adds the Move to button to each card.

options.name: minColumnWidth
options.description: The narrowest a column gets. A phone shows one column per page; wider screens as many as fit.

options.name: pagerState
options.description: The state of the pager, to choose the first column shown or follow the column in view.

options.name: menuIcon
options.description: An icon for the Move to button. null shows the word Move.

options.name: cardContent
options.description: The content of a card after the handle, such as a MonarchIssueCard.

states.name: dragging
states.description: After a long press a copy of the card follows the finger with a large shadow and the accent border; its place shows a muted placeholder, and an accent line shows where it will land.

states.name: turning the page
states.description: Holding the finger at the start or end of the board for 600 milliseconds shows the previous or next column; near the top or bottom of a column the column scrolls.

states.name: refused
states.description: A column canMove refuses, or a full one with enforceWipLimits, gets the danger border and "Not allowed here" while the card is over it; a drop there is refused and announced. In the Move to menu it is disabled.

states.name: at and over the limit
states.description: The count reads "2 / 2" in the strong warning color at the limit and in the strong danger color over it; TalkBack reads "2 cards, limit 2, at the limit".

states.name: pending
states.description: While onMove runs the card stays in its new place and its state has pending true.

states.name: failed
states.description: When onMove throws, the card goes back and "Could not move Fix login. It is back in To do." is announced.

states.name: locked and read only
states.description: A card itemEnabled refuses, every card when enabled is false, and every card without onMove has no handle, no menu and cannot be dragged.

states.name: empty
states.description: A column with no cards shows its emptyText, or "No cards".

appearance: Columns are panels in the subtle background color with a subtle border and the large radius; cards are surface-coloured with a subtle border and the medium radius. Column titles use the subheading style; counts the caption style in the muted text color, warning at the limit and danger over it. The tabs use the surface color, with the accent color for the selected tab. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web lays all columns side by side and scrolls the board sideways; on a phone the board is a pager with one column per page and a tab row of the columns, the pattern Android apps use for boards, and wider screens show as many columns as fit at minColumnWidth. A long press anywhere on a card starts the drag (the web's dragFrom option is not needed on touch). The board does not reorder cards during the drag; it shows a line where the card will land and moves it on drop. The keyboard pick-up mode of the web is replaced by the handle's four TalkBack actions and arrow keys, each saving one step. The Move to menu is on by default here (off on the web) so a single-tap path always exists. Columns cannot collapse: with one column per page there is nothing to save room for. defaultColumns, onMoveError, dragFrom, collapsible and headingLevel are not offered; onMove is a suspend function whose exception reports the failure. Announcements use a polite live region where the web uses an assertive one. Icons are app-supplied slots because Monarch bundles no icons. There is no iOS entry yet.
accessibility: Each column title is a heading; its count is read in words, such as "1 card, limit 2".
The column tabs are Material 3 tabs with the selected state.
Each card's handle is named "Move Fix login" and offers Move up, Move down, Move backward and Move forward actions; moving to another column shows that column.
The Move to button is named "Move Fix login to another column" and opens a menu of the other columns; refused columns are disabled.
Pick up, drop, each move, cancel, a refused drop and a failed save are announced through a polite live region that is always present.
The copy that follows the finger is hidden from TalkBack.
Tabs, handles and Move to buttons have 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: The board shows a saved move until onMove returns and the app passes the new columns list; passing a new list instance replaces it.
Dropping a card where it was does not call onMove.
Give the board a bounded height: each column is a lazy list.
Move backward and Move forward skip refused columns and keep the card's position, clamped to the end of the column.
With enforceWipLimits a column that is already over its limit keeps its cards and still lets them move within it.
Long titles and card text wrap; cards grow at font scale 2.0.

A column that takes no cards and a locked card
examples.code:
MonarchKanbanBoard(
    columns = columns,
    key = { it.key },
    itemLabel = { it.key },
    modifier = Modifier.height(400.dp),
    onMove = { _, _ -> },
    canMove = { _, to, _ -> to != "released" },
    itemEnabled = { it.key != "ABC-2" },
) { issue, _ ->
    MonarchText(text = issue.key, style = MonarchTextStyle.Code)
    MonarchText(text = issue.title)
}
